{
  "skills": [
    {
      "skill_id": "polarity_core_halogen_penalty_refined",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "heteroatom_rich_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_high"},
          "weight": 0.85,
          "rationale": "Multiple N/O sites donate and accept hydrogen bonds to water, the dominant favorable term in hydration free energy."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "moderate_heteroatom_bonus",
          "conditions": {"hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_mid"},
          "weight": 0.4,
          "rationale": "Few polar sites still add favorable solute-water contacts without burying them under a large apolar scaffold."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "halogen_heavy_penalty",
          "conditions": {"halogen_bin": "halogen_high"},
          "weight": -0.65,
          "rationale": "Halogen-rich solutes are apolar and poorly solvated; polarizability alone does not offset the loss of hydrogen bonding."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "aromatic_apolar_penalty",
          "conditions": {"aromatic_bin": "aromatic_high"},
          "weight": -0.45,
          "rationale": "Fused aromatic scaffolds are flat and hydrophobic; pi density is weakly hydrating versus polar substituent groups."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 0.9,
      "prior_scale": 0.45,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.5,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.2,
      "ucb_weight": 0.55,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.0,
      "gp_beta_end": 0.9,
      "gp_xi": 0.02,
      "confidence": 0.7,
      "hypothesis": "Retains the polarity mechanism that won on development seeds, adding an aromatic-apolar penalty to sharpen the low end. It fails if aromatic species with polar substituents occupy the top of the hydration pool."
    },
    {
      "skill_id": "ring_topology_hbond_proxy_counter",
      "rules": [
        {
          "rule_id": "ring_high_penalty",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_high"},
          "weight": -0.6,
          "rationale": "Reverses the uncertain source ring prior: rigid polycyclic solutes pack apolar surface and solvate poorly in water."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "polar_ring_strain_reversal",
          "conditions": {"ring_token_bin": "ring_token_none", "hetero_atom_bin": "hetero_none"},
          "weight": -0.5,
          "rationale": "Acyclic and heteroatom-free together mark pure hydrocarbons, whose hydration is entropically costly despite the acyclic bonus."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "branched_mid_apolar_penalty",
          "conditions": {"branch_bin": "branch_high"},
          "weight": -0.4,
          "rationale": "Highly branched skeletons raise hydrophobic surface area and reduce favorable water contact per heavy atom."
        },
        {
          "rule_id": "double_bond_polarity_bonus",
          "conditions": {"double_bond_bin": "double_bond_mid"},
          "weight": 0.3,
          "rationale": "Unsaturated centers often accompany carbonyl and imine groups, which are strong hydration acceptors."
        }
      ],
      "ridge": 1.0,
      "prior_scale": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_start": 0.4,
      "semantic_mass_end": 0.12,
      "ucb_weight": 0.6,
      "gp_beta_start": 2.1,
      "gp_beta_end": 1.0,
      "gp_xi": 0.015,
      "confidence": 0.5,
      "hypothesis": "Tests whether ring topology and unsaturation proxy hydrogen-bonding capacity, downweighting the high-transfer-weight source ring relation. It fails if ring presence genuinely tracks favorable hydration in the top pool."
    }
  ],
  "selected_skill_id": "polarity_core_halogen_penalty_refined",
  "lesson": "The polarity mechanism generalized strongly across all eight development seeds (mean AUC ~83 versus ~51 for the transferred ESOL size prior), so refinements should keep heteroatom and halogen polarity terms central and treat source length and ring relations as low-confidence priors.",
  "revision_summary": "Kept the deployed polarity core, replacing the short-plus-apolar interaction term with an aromatic-apolar penalty and slightly relaxing semantic mass decay. Proposes a complementary counter-skill that reverses the high-transfer-weight ring relation and adds branch, ring, and unsaturation topology terms as hydrogen-bonding proxies, and retains the polarity core for deployment."
